answer: Nebula Voting Mechanism enforces identity through cumulative participation taxes. Each new voting identity must pay an entry cost equal to the square root of total existing voters, calculated dynamically. This makes creating thousands of fake identities prohibitively expensive as the user base grows. In the tundra of governance, attackers face exponentially rising costs that scale with legitimate participation rather than arbitrary thresholds.
